solutions.title: Sort by distance
solutions.strategy: Sort every point by squared distance and take the first k points.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting n points dominates the work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The sorted copy or sort internals can store up to n point references.

solutions.title: Size-k max heap
solutions.strategy: Keep a heap of the current k best points and evict the farthest point whenever the heap grows too large.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each point performs at most one heap insertion and possibly one removal from a size-k heap.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only k candidate points are retained.
